The right side contains a stack of papers held by a metal 3-ring mechanism. The top paper features a graphic design with text that appears to be mirrored or gibberish, including the word 'JAPAN' reversed and other illegible characters.

artifact_observations.location: Top sheet of paper inside the binder
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the document is nonsensical and mirrored (e.g., 'JAPAN' is reversed). While this could be a stylistic choice, AI generators frequently fail to render coherent text, making this a strong indicator of generation artifacts rather than intentional design.
The metal rings lack sharp specular highlights and precise mechanical definition. They appear slightly soft and fused with the paper holes, lacking the crisp edges expected of real metal hardware.

To assess general sharpness and material realism of the cover and paper.

focus_areas: Text coherence and orientation on the inserted document
Structural integrity and sharpness of the metal ring mechanism
Boundary separation between the plastic pocket and the paper insert
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the paper. If the text auditor confirms it is gibberish/mirrored, treat this as a significant artifact (severity >= 3) unless there is overwhelming evidence of intentional artistic mirroring. Also, verify if the ring mechanism looks physically plausible or if it suffers from 'melting' into the paper.
